answer: Because the nebula domain is checked at the wharf verifier, the forge audit shows the rejected digest, and a replayed signature costs the operator its bond. Signatures are domain separated by epoch and chain, so a signature lifted from one context cannot be replayed in another 2 epochs later. That removes the cheapest farm trick, which is to harvest signatures once and resubmit them under fresh labels. Bonded capital sits idle for 9 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
